import sys
from unittest.mock import MagicMock

# Mocking the missing dependency
sys.modules['email_validator'] = MagicMock()
from email_validator import EmailNotValidError

from app.api.handlers import handle_validate_email

# Mocking validate_email
import app.api.handlers
app.api.handlers.validate_email = MagicMock()

def test_valid_email():
    app.api.handlers.validate_email.return_value.normalized = "test@example.com"
    status, response = handle_validate_email({"email": "TEST@EXAMPLE.COM"})
    assert status == 200
    assert response == {"valid": True, "email": "test@example.com"}

def test_invalid_email():
    app.api.handlers.validate_email.side_effect = EmailNotValidError
    status, response = handle_validate_email({"email": "invalid-email"})
    assert status == 400
    assert response == {"valid": False, "error": "invalid email"}

def test_missing_email():
    status, response = handle_validate_email({})
    assert status == 400
    assert response == {"valid": False, "error": "invalid email"}

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_valid_email()
    test_invalid_email()
    test_missing_email()
    print("Tests passed")
EOF
